leagues.name: Metropolitan Hockey League (MHL)
leagues.notes: Multi‑association house league with published schedules / standings; members include Everett / Jr Kraken / Kent Valley / Seattle Junior / Sno‑King / Tacoma / West Sound.

leagues.name: Metropolitan Hockey League — Girls Division
leagues.notes: Girls-only rec teams play league games across the Puget Sound region within MHL.

leagues.name: PNAHA League (A/B travel)
leagues.notes: State affiliate administers league schedules / standings for WA travel levels; used by Tier II and B teams from WA associations.

leagues.name: Northwest Amateur Hockey League (NWAHL)
leagues.notes: Tier II league with regional divisions to reduce travel; WA members have included Sno‑King Jr Thunderbirds / Tri‑Cities Jr Americans.

leagues.name: Western Washington High School Hockey League — Division 1
leagues.governingBody: Western Washington High School Hockey League (WWHSHL)
leagues.notes: Club high school league with standings / schedules; not WIAA‑sanctioned.

leagues.name: Western Washington High School Hockey League — Division 2
leagues.governingBody: Western Washington High School Hockey League (WWHSHL)
leagues.notes: Second tier of WWHSHL with its own standings / stats.

leagues.name: Tri‑Cities High School Hockey League (TCHSHL)
leagues.governingBody: Operated by Tri‑Cities Amateur Hockey Association (TCAHA)
leagues.notes: TCAHA runs seasonal high school league play (separate from WIAA); schedules published each season.

leagues.name: Western Washington Female Hockey League (WWFHL)
leagues.notes: All‑girls recreational league with weekly games and standings for teens.
